mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_resource_stats (tenant_id, resource_id, resource_name, resource_type, stat_date, order_count, total_revenue, avg_rating, rating_count, working_hours, efficiency_score, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{resourceId}, #{resourceName}, #{resourceType}, #{statDate}, #{orderCount}, #{totalRevenue}, #{avgRating}, #{ratingCount}, #{workingHours}, #{efficiencyScore}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE resource_name = #{resourceName}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, order_count = #{orderCount}, total_revenue = #{totalRevenue}, avg_rating = #{avgRating}, rating_count = #{ratingCount}, working_hours = #{workingHours}, efficiency_score = #{efficiencyScore}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP()
mapper.select: SELECT resource_id as resourceId, resource_name as resourceName, resource_type as resourceType, SUM(order_count) as orderCount, SUM(total_revenue) as totalRevenue, CASE WHEN SUM(rating_count) > 0 THEN SUM(avg_rating * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count) ELSE 0 END as avgRating, AVG(efficiency_score) as efficiencyScore FROM daily_resource_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY resource_id, resource_name, resource_type ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(rating_count) > 0 THEN SUM(avg_rating * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count) ELSE 0 END FROM daily_resource_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND rating_count > 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_resource_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
